description: This file contains utility functions for handling cooldown logic for deployments in a router. It manages adding deployments to cooldowns based on error rates, exceptions, and specific status codes, and provides functions to retrieve current cooldown deployments asynchronously or synchronously. It references external modules for logging, constants, and callbacks, and defines several internal helper functions to encapsulate decision logic about when to cooldown.

methods.name: bool _is_cooldown_required( litellm_router_instance: LitellmRouter, model_id: str, exception_status: Union[str, int], exception_str: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Determines whether a cooldown is required based on exception status and certain conditions.

methods.name: bool _should_run_cooldown_logic( litellm_router_instance: LitellmRouter, deployment: Optional[str], exception_status: Union[str, int], original_exception: Any, time_to_cooldown: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Decides if cooldown logic should be executed for a deployment given various conditions.

methods.name: bool _should_cooldown_deployment( litellm_router_instance: LitellmRouter, deployment: str, exception_status: Union[str, int], original_exception: Any, )
methods.description: Checks if a deployment should be put on cooldown based on recent failure metrics and error codes.

methods.name: bool _set_cooldown_deployments( litellm_router_instance: LitellmRouter, original_exception: Any, exception_status: Union[str, int], deployment: Optional[str] = None, time_to_cooldown: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Adds a deployment to the cooldown list if it exceeds failure thresholds or error conditions.

methods.name: List[str] _async_get_cooldown_deployments( litellm_router_instance: LitellmRouter, parent_otel_span: Optional[Span], )
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of deployments currently in cooldown.

methods.name: List[tuple] _async_get_cooldown_deployments_with_debug_info( litellm_router_instance: LitellmRouter, parent_otel_span: Optional[Span], )
methods.description: Async version that provides detailed debug info about cooldown models.

methods.name: List[str] _get_cooldown_deployments( litellm_router_instance: LitellmRouter, parent_otel_span: Optional[Span] )
methods.description: Synchronously retrieves the list of current cooldown deployments.

methods.name: bool should_cooldown_based_on_allowed_fails_policy( litellm_router_instance: LitellmRouter, deployment: str, original_exception: Any, )
methods.description: Decides if a deployment should cooldown based on allowed fails policy and incrementing fail count.

methods.description: Checks if custom allowed fails configuration is set on the router.
